reviewed_semantics.result: Closed data-object member descriptors and native intrinsic byte slots reject proxy/getter/shared/forged inputs. Every field and aggregate is admitted before owned copies; packets must be null. No transport callback or writer is exposed.

Fatal UTF-8, duplicate members, surrogate, finite numeric, depth/node admission and exact Python-compatible canonical escape accounting bound the new inputs and derived artifact; reservations include both fixed-width hashes and newline.

The new dataset/source reader opens one nonblocking nofollow FD, admits regular/size before allocation, loops bounded reads plus one overflow observation, checks same FD metadata and relinquishes before one close. Whole original scorer/helper closure plus module/guide are captured on load and checked at entry and after scoring.

Synthetic-software-fixture/closed/provider-model-only admission, zero tool traces, exact question envelopes and held nested context/tool metadata. The SAME owned dataset buffer is hashed before parsing; fixed seed20261001/15items/3perfive templates and item/question/expected/cited bindings are checked.

Only completed items with all declared positions and no pending records score. The inherited auditor enforces named final successful raw response is maximum ordinal and matches declared final count. Missing/error/aborted/notstarted/incomplete/pending remain false/null scored rows in the full15 denominator; earlier answers are never selected.

Unchanged scoreAnswer/behaviour preserve unit/malformed/abstention/invention semantics, twelve answerable/three unanswerable full denominators, and numbers_wrong null when no numbers. The complete unchanged accounting companion is included and hash-bound; unknown usage/latency/prices/billing remain null with known partial subtotals.
Replay owns input/artifact bytes, strict-parses, recomputes full artifact and canonical equality; rehashing score/status/measurement/source/input fields cannot make them match recomputation.

meaningful_written_test_names: full correct fixed cohort retains exact accounting companion and deterministically replays fifteen rows
mixed wrong units abstention malformed answers and formatted numeric invention preserve original scorer behaviour
all abstentions keep full answerable denominators and numbers_wrong null rather than invented zero
earlier correct final wrong and earlier wrong final correct each score only the named last attempt
raw429 followed by an explicit retry preserves failed usage costs and retry accounting
missing error aborted not-started incomplete and pending records all remain denominator failures
completed labels with undeclared or missing earlier attempt positions become explicit incomplete rows
blank or missing ANSWER markers stay denominator failures and absent final raw bindings are refused
all missing captures preserve full cohort and unavailable usage latency price and billing
incomplete usage and clocks retain nulls with labeled known subtotals without affecting valid final scoring
malformed retained raw error responses preserve unavailable measurements and cannot become scored answers
delivered collector completes actual synthetic capture and read-only recovery then scoring and replay
collector interruption after raw persistence recovers pending without resubmission and keeps full denominator
non-synthetic purposes arms providers observed models packets and tool traces are refused before scoring
source context hidden request fields response metadata and settings metadata cannot enter a closed fixture
baseline expected sample question projection accounting and raw answer binding tampering are refused
physically changed dataset bytes fail same-buffer binding before scoring without touching the repository
transient same-length scoring read swap cannot hash one dataset and parse another
post-load comment changes in every scoring helper and the whole new module or guide are refused
whole-module comment mutation during captured dataset read is caught by post-scoring source recheck
rehashed row score status measurement implementation and input tampering are rejected by full replay
native input admission refuses parsed strings shared arrays proxies getters and unknown members without invoking hooks
intrinsic byte views ignore hostile own length getters and input copies precede source filesystem callbacks
oversized native fields are refused before any source open or owned allocation
invalid UTF8 duplicate members lone surrogates nonfinite JSON and excessive nesting are refused
bounded raw ASCII NUL BMP and astral answers reserve full canonical expansion before derived encoding
settings raw request response and replay artifact each enforce their separate finite byte caps
one-descriptor nonblocking read refuses symlink nonregular oversize and changed metadata before scoring
close-after-close failure does not retry a reused unrelated descriptor or acknowledge scoring
network process and credential positive guards stay untouched by scorer replay and root dataset reads stay read-only
tests_reviewed_as_source: All21727Bmodule+35520Btest+7622Bguide fully read. Thirty cases cover delivered collector/recovery without resubmit, all statuses/final ordering, raw429/null measurements, same-buffer swaps, postload/during-scoring comment edits, raw/Unicode/caps, close-FD-reuse and armed positive network/process controls. No cases executed by reviewer.
scope_limits: Static review only; separate independent retained-current-CI gate required.
Synthetic source/data declarations are not provider/model execution or verified source completeness/rights/human labels/authentic billing.
Trusted private checkout/runtime. Same-FD identity checks do not exclude entirely-between-checks same-user ABA, hostile parent directories, altered JS runtime, or universal wall time.
Inherited baseline/accounting readers and source-input behavior remain unchanged; artifact1MiB cap does not claim all intermediate encoding or every bounded raw input fits.
No archive allocation, final-head/ordinary merge, browser/live publication or actual indexing/adoption/qualified finance outcome acknowledged.
